explanation: Action carries Player and Running onto Target. In each following no-input turn the rigid group tries to move Crate right into Wall, while the independent color rule draws before that failure. Retry restores the no-Done board, bans the rigid group, and draws again. Native AGAIN first probes (draws one and two), restores only the board, then actually runs (draws three and four). explanation: Action reaches Target with Running, checkpoints that pre-color board, then requests AGAIN. Native probe draw one of split-colors-5 is 0.4640369099043778 (Red); it queues restart, pushes its pre-probe board to history, then restores its random object change through a second push/pop. That leaves one extra pre-AGAIN history snapshot. Actual draw two is 0.5014220301644389 (Blue), commits Done Blue and emits creation 752. One undo therefore returns to the checkpoint board and a second undo reaches the initial board. Labs isolates the probe and actually commits first-draw Red: restart outputs sfx0=750, restores the checkpoint and leaves its real restart history entry. Because fixture undo ignores duplicate boards, Labs skips that real restart snapshot when it equals the restored checkpoint and reaches the initial board with one undo. The Red creation mask still emits 751 after restart, although the Red object was restored away. Its next tick draws two and commits Blue, whereas native Blue is already Done and draws nothing. Restart and undo never rewind RNG or erase sound history.
